scope: Explicitly adjudicated challenges in the current thread-by-thread review. This is not a retrospective score for every argument across the entire conversation.
counting_rules: One distinct challenge is scored once; restatements and source follow-ups do not create additional points.
A successful defense means the attempted objection was not sustained; it does not independently establish the full supernatural conclusion.
An assistant qualification is not recorded as a concession by Daniel unless he actually accepts it.
Open challenges receive no victory points. Explicitly agreed partial credit for a separate evidentiary finding is recorded separately and does not close an open challenge.
Reopening a closed challenge requires substantive new evidence or a new argument, with the earlier result preserved.

discussion_updates.user_argument: The directions of spectators who appear to be watching can corroborate that the lower shadow source was the light they saw.
discussion_updates.method: Estimate 3D head directions from six selected faces in the public D115 scan and compare them with the lower shadow direction in a level frame using Dalleur's camera assumptions.
discussion_updates.result: Five of six head estimates point up and right. The six-head average is about 42 degrees right and 10 degrees up. Dalleur's lower shadow source is about 35 degrees right and 28 degrees up. The broad directional agreement supports the proposed link.
discussion_updates.limits: Some head estimates shift by tens of degrees when inputs change. The pupils are too indistinct to measure gaze, and the single exposure leaves the phase of motion unresolved.

Luis Antonio Vieira de Magalhaes e Vasconcelos, Coimbra-trained lawyer, testimony 30 December 1917: DCF I, Doc. 28; selected edition Doc. 32. Records a relative's account of inducements and threats of burning or being thrown into a well. Fr. Manuel Nunes Formigao's account of questioning on 11 October 1917: DCF I, Doc. 12; selected edition Doc. 11. Lucia affirms the miracle and denies fear of harm if nothing happens. Editors date the surviving literary redaction likely after 13 October, within that month.
